sources.name: default
content: # - rounds and dance-specific heats are persisted
# - judging marks and calculated result values are persisted for traceability
# - scoring calculation logic itself is intentionally excluded and expected to be
# - blue = event configuration data, no changes during event, e.g. person, organization, competition_type, dance
# - green = event data, e.g. event, participant, competition, round, teamup, mark
# - fuchsia = schedule data, e.g. timeslot, syncpoint
# - gray = traceability data, e.g. logs, hashes
# - orange = external references, e.g. external ids
# PLEASE NOTE: color property from AML is currently ignored by azimutt! :-(
type person_sex (not_known, male, female, non_binary, not_applicable)
organization_external_id {color: orange} | Allows one organization to carry multiple identifiers from different external systems such as DTV ESV or DETV.
federation {color: blue} | A federation is also represented as an organization. Display data such as name and code are sourced from organization. Examples: DTV, WDSF.
note text nullable | OrganizerOrganizationId is optional. Effective organizer is organizer_organization_id ?? host_organization_id.
floor {color: green} | event_id is intentionally denormalized for uniqueness and simpler references. It must match the event of the referenced hall.
status participant_status(registered, withdrawn, present, started, completed, disqualified, canceled)=registered
The participant type defines whether a participant is a pair, solo, duo, group, or any future structure.
A single observable, scheduled contest for a ranking between competing participants.
- normally, defined by a single start class and age group
- if age classes and/or age groups are combined, *competition* represents the combination
(i.e. all participants competing at the same *time*)
status competition_status_type(planned, ready, running, completed, aborted, canceled)=planned
league_id uuid nullable -> league(id) | only used for league competitions
rel competition <> age_group   | n:m relation between competitions and age groups (m > 1 required for combinations)
rel competition <> start_class | n:m relation between competitions and start classes (m > 1 required for combinations)
rel competition <> floor       | default floor(s) assigned to the competition (to select round-specific floor assignments from)
A "default" dance for a competition, defining superset of dances available for each round, and their order.
Note: This is almost just a join entity, but we also need sequence_no for ordering.
dance_id uuid -> dance | note: not unique, to support repeated dances in a round (e.g. Jack & Jill)
rel competition_dance <> round | subset of dances selected for each round, using ordering from competition_dance.sequence_no
participant_status_event {color: green} | Stores status changes such as registration, check-in, withdrawal, disqualification, cancellation, and corrections.
reason text nullable | mandatory for changes relevant to competition report
kind round_kind(general_look, classification, preliminary, redance, intermediate, semifinal, final, placement, tie_breaker)
status round_status(planned, ready, running, paused, completed, published, canceled)=planned
rel round <> floor | floor selection for each round, (usually) subset of competition default floors
teamup {color: green} | a judged party, e.g. a couple (one participant) or a temporary Jack & Jill team (two participants), dancing in a heat
Assignment of participants to teamups, n:1 in "classical" cases, e.g. n:2 for Jack & Jill.
Note: a participant may (technically) join multiple heats in the same round, e.g. on lack of leaders in Jack & Jill
Contains all attributes that apply to a judge's activity within a certain round.
Please note that this requires the linked referenced account to possess the corresponding jury role, but the latter is not formally modeled (TBD?).
floor_id uuid nullable -> floor | only for multi-floor rounds (e.g. university sports), otherwise null
position_code varchar nullable | only for formations, otherwise null
last_active timestamptz nullable | last time the judge was active in the round (e.g. round selection or last mark submission)
confirmed_dances_count int=0 | number of dances already completed by the judge (e.g. to enforce r/o during marks presentation)
Stores an actual mark given by one judge for one participant and one dance,
such as a selection mark, placement, numeric score, lift, disqualification, or absent mark.
participant_id uuid -> participant | note: in case of a multi-participant teamup, *all* participants must receive marks
account_id uuid -> account | account under which the judge is working
kind mark_kind(selection, placement, score, lift, disqualification, absent, interrupt)
value numeric nullable | numeric value shall always be given if possible (e.g. last place for disqualification, absent, or canceled)
reason text nullable | optional (usually sufficiently reflected by kind)
evaluation {color: green} | Flexible key-value result output for DSL and evaluation traceability.
key_path varchar        ||| unique sequence of keys, seperated by ':', syntax: [a-zA-Z0-9_]*(:[a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*
example: "SF:3:sum" for Slow Foxtrot, place 3 and better, sum of marks" |||
value varchar nullable  | usually numeric value, string representation for flexibility
reason text nullable    | reason for the value, e.g. "disqualified for lift", ideally with rule reference
result_log_id uuid -> result_log | log reference for legal traceability
Stores the official placement after a round, which is the competition result if the round is the final one.
Detailed traceability values are stored in table evaluation, which also redundantly include the final result.
start_class_id uuid nullable -> start_class | non-null only used in combined competition for focussed placement
age_group_id uuid nullable -> age_group | non-null only used in combined competition for foussed placement
is_final boolean=false | true iff this is the final result of the competition
result_log_id uuid -> result_log | log reference for legal traceability
Stores traceability hashes on result calculation. Used for both intermediate and final results.
Outdated entries will remain if the calculation is re-run.
dsl_hash varchar               | hash of the DSL source code used for calculation
result_hash varchar nullable   | hash of the result data used for calculation (nullable since record must be created *before* calculation)
account_id uuid -> account     | user account that triggered the calculation
client_id varchar              | id of client machine from which the calculation was triggered
calculated_time timestamptz    | timestamp of the calculation
timeslot {color: fuchsia} | a schedule entry, something that occupies a time period on one or more floors
competition_id uuid nullable -> competition | non-null iff competition-related (including non-judged, like intro or GL)
round_id uuid nullable -> round | non-null iff round-related (including non-judged, like GL) and round exists
kind timeslot_kind(other, intro, practice, presentation, awards, break, goodbye, round)
round_kind round_kind nullable | iff kind = round
status timeslot_status(planned, ready, running, completed, canceled)
heat_duration_s int | expected duration of a heat, in seconds
buffer_duration_s int | expected buffer time for set-up and finishing, in seconds
expected_duration_s int | expected duration of the timeslot, in seconds
actual_duration_s int | actual duration of the timeslot, in seconds
predecessor_syncpoint_id uuid -> syncpoint | this timeslot starts with the given syncpoint
successor_syncpoint_id uuid -> syncpoint | this triggers the given syncpoint
rel timeslot <> floor | a floor assigned to a timeslot
syncpoint {color: fuchsia} | a point in time that defines a sequence between 'predecessor' and 'successor' timeslot(s)
time timestamptz | planned or actual time (planned-time field not helpful due to permanent re-planning)
earliest_time timestamptz nullable | if set, wait until this time has been reached (e.g. announced start time)
external {color: orange} | stores one or more external pk's for various kinds of TAS records (polymorphic, expandable)
kind external_kind(organization, event, competition, participant, person)
idspace {color: orange} | a namespace for external identifiers, e.g. DTV ESV, DETV, WDSF, etc.
event_id uuid -> event | for client discrimination

sources.name: accounts-marek
content: login varchar | should use email address for personal accounts
password_text varchar nullable | non-null only permitted for non-personal accounts
person_id uuid nullable -> person(id) | null only permitted for event-specific accounts
organization_id uuid nullable -> organization | non-null only permitted for global accounts
role | config: a role configured for a spefic organization, or a global one
organization_id uuid nullable -> organization(id) | null: global role, non-null: organization-specific role
role_scope | a role assignment to an account
competition_id uuid nullable -> competition | null: event scope, non-null: competition scope
floor_id uuid nullable -> floor | only relevant for judges (classical cases: null)
license | config: a license configured for a specific organization, or a global one
organization_id uuid nullable -> organization(id) | null: global license, non-null: organization-specific license
rel person <> license | a license assigned to a person
name varchar unique | used by backend code to look-up a permission
rel role <> permission | config: a permission assigned to a role
